items.text: Little optimism Eagles WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) plays Sunday vs Rams; sidelined this week, expectation he won’t go. Sources to McManus/Garafolo.
items.why: Hamstring issues, DNP practices; prior camp history but trending wrong.
items.implication: Hurts ceiling drops; Wicks/Goedert/others rise in target share.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets for Dontayvion Wicks and secondary pass-catchers.

items.text: Saints placing RB Travis Etienne on injured reserve due to hamstring injury; out at least 4 games, earliest return Week 9 after bye. No surgery needed.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated in Week 3 vs Raiders after prior issues; coach Moore confirms multi-week timeline.
items.implication: Saints backfield committee shifts; Kamara and Miller primary beneficiaries for volume.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps/targets for remaining RBs in NO offense.

items.text: Rams HC Sean McVay expects WR Puka Nacua (hip/groin) to play Sunday vs Eagles; practiced limited then trending full. Schefter notes Rams get Nacua back as Eagles prep without Smith.
items.why: McVay confirmation after limited practice and positive reports; twisted to catch ball as good sign.
items.implication: Elite WR1 return boosts Rams passing attack; Adams volume may dilute slightly.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets/red-zone share restoration for Nacua.

items.text: Ravens injury report: Lamar Jackson and Zay Flowers among those upgraded to full participants Thursday.
items.why: Practice upgrade after prior limitations (Jackson back, Flowers hamstring history).
items.implication: Both expected to play at full strength; Flowers efficiency high on limited snaps previously.
items.opportunity: Full snap/route share for Flowers; Jackson rushing/passing upside unlocked.

items.text: Bears RB D'Andre Swift added to injury report with knee, DNP Thursday (new mid-week issue after full prior). Status for Week 4 vs Jets uncertain; monitor Friday.
items.why: Sudden addition to report with DNP; not rest-related.
items.implication: If out/limited, Monangai sees major volume boost.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup snaps and carries spike potential.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren @ CLE (TNF): 90% snap rate last week, 20/22 RB touches with Dowdle out. CLE allows 88+ rush yards every game; full workhorse.
items.why: Elite usage (snaps/touches) + matchup; top-10 play despite short week.
items.implication: Strong RB1/2 start; volume lock if Dowdle remains out.

items.text: LOVE Drake London @ NO: 35% target share/104 ypg career with Penix; 43.5% share (9-194) in return last week. NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
items.why: Penix chemistry + high target share + matchup.

items.text: ETR fresh ROS Top-150 rankings: Kenneth Walker ranked 3rd overall. Notable high placement amid other risers like Parker Washington 22, Saquon 30.
items.why: Updated ROS based on current usage/performance; trade calculator refreshed.
items.implication: Strong buy/hold signal; elite RB1 ROS value.

items.text: Packers WR Jayden Reed set for season-ending neck surgery; placed on IR.
items.why: Neck injury requiring surgery per Demovsky/ESPN.
items.implication: GB WR depth thins; Wicks/Watson/others benefit long-term.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining Packers pass-catchers ROS.

items.text: LOVE Trevor Lawrence @ CIN: 19+ FP in 8 of last 9; highest O/U 51.5 this week. Prior vs CIN: 271/3 TDs. Great spot/environment.
HATE Justin Herbert @ SEA: Pressured 44% dropbacks; SEA 4th pressure rate, league-low 5.0 YPA/7.7 YPC. Bottom-3 implied total.
items.why: Pressure + elite pass defense + low total.

items.text: HATE Kyle Pitts @ NO (16% share/34 ypg career w/ Penix; TE37 util) and Omarion Hampton @ SEA (low target/route %, 42% snaps W3; SEA 2.9 YPC allowed).
items.why: Poor usage/history for Pitts; limited role + tough run D for Hampton.

items.text: Seahawks designated RB Zach Charbonnet to return to practice.
items.implication: Potential activation soon; impacts SEA RB committee (Walker/Price).

items.text: Kyle Pitts has six targets through three games, none inside the 10, low aDOT. Among worst underperformers relative to opportunity so far.
items.why: Data on targets/aDOT/red-zone; chart of opportunity vs results.
items.implication: Fade in rankings/start-sit despite Penix return; low efficiency/volume.
